title: Internship certificate
description: Certificate of completion of an internship, numbered in the HR certificate series.

params.title: INTERNSHIP COMPLETION CERTIFICATE
paragraphs: This is to certify that **{fullName}** has successfully completed an internship with **{company}** as **{designation}** from **{startDate}** to **{endDate}**.

paragraphs.text: During the internship, {firstName} worked on the tasks assigned by the team and showed a sound understanding of the work, a readiness to learn and consistency in meeting goals.

paragraphs: Throughout the internship, {firstName} was diligent, cooperative and committed, and their conduct was found to be good.
We thank {firstName} for their contribution and wish them every success in the future.

fields.name: honorific
fields.label: Honorific
fields.help: Mr., Ms., Dr. … (printed before the name)

fields.name: salutationName
fields.label: Short name
fields.help: Used in the body; default: the first name

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Work summary
fields.help: A paragraph on the work done; replaces the generic second paragraph
